remarks: Embrace Metropolitan living in the SoNo Lofts. From the moment you step inside this FURNISHED rental, be captivated by the open floor plan, lofty ceilings, designer lighting, polished concrete floors, and generous natural light streaming through oversized windows which all work to create an ambiance of sophistication. The kitchen is a culinary dream, boasting sleek cabinetry, sparkling tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances, including a convenient wine cooler. Retreat to the lower level bedroom that offers a custom-designed walk-in California Closet, a tastefully updated ensuite bathroom, and thoughtfully incorporated custom built-ins for additional storage. Unit comes fully furnished. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Includes gated garage parking and wifi! The complex itself boasts a fitness center, and bike storage room. Experience the perfect blend of contemporary luxury and urban convenience, mere seconds from everything SoNo has to offer: shopping at the SoNo Collection, easy access to the South Norwalk train station, Maritime Aquarium, theater, vibrant nightlife, Veteran's Memorial Park, and picturesque shoreline and more.
